about: Source of truth for every Krea-generated 3D model. Fable adds entries as models are made; tools/krea_assets.py turns this into public/props/krea/manifest.json (optimised GLBs + thumbnails). Raw files live outside the repo in ../../Refs/krea3d/<id>_raw.glb, <id>_preview.png (Hunyuan render), <id>_ref.png (Krea reference image).

models.name: Myrtle Av-Broadway station house
models.description: Mezzanine, glass-block elevator tower and street stair of the J/M/Z station, from Wikimedia Commons photos.

models.name: Platform section with canopy
models.description: 12 m covered side platform: green steel canopy on bracketed columns, yellow tactile edge, bench. Tiled 60 m at Myrtle.

models.name: Open platform section
models.description: 12 m open side platform: double-globe lamp post, picket fence, concrete-cased column. Tiled at both platform ends.

models.name: Elevated structure bent
models.description: One section of the riveted green steel el over Broadway, repeated along the whole J route.

models.name: Bushwick corner tenement
models.description: Three-storey brick tenement with cornice, fire escapes and a shop at street level. Fitted to the nearest 3-storey footprints.

models.name: Corner fast-food block
models.description: One-storey corner block with three storefronts and roof units, on the footprint across from the station.

models.name: Four-storey walk-up
models.description: Red brick apartment walk-up with zig-zag fire escapes and two shops behind graffiti roll-down gates, from J-line window footage on Broadway.

models.name: Ornate corner building
models.description: Late-1800s buff stone corner building with a rounded bay, arched top windows and a dentil cornice, from J-line window footage.

models.name: Graffiti loft with water tower
models.description: Three-storey Bushwick brick warehouse covered in graffiti, steel factory windows, a wooden NYC water tower on the roof.

models.name: El street stair
models.description: Street-level stair up to the el with green railings, a red-brown canopy and a subway globe, from Commons photos of J-line stations.

models.name: One-storey storefront row
models.description: Three small shops under the el on Broadway with coloured sign bands and tagged roll-down shutters.

models.name: Bushwick frame house
models.description: Two-and-a-half storey row house in beige vinyl siding with a concrete stoop and chain-link front fence.

models.name: Brooklyn brownstone
models.description: Brownstone row house with a high stoop, curved cast-iron railings, carved lintels and a bracketed cornice.

models.name: Corner deli
models.description: Two-storey brick corner building with a yellow deli sign band, striped awnings and posters behind the glass.

models.name: Six-storey pre-war apartment house
models.description: Tan brick pre-war apartment block with fire escapes, a stone entrance surround and a rooftop water tower.

models.name: Graffiti auto garage
models.description: One-storey cinder-block repair garage with roll-up doors, covered in Bushwick graffiti murals.

models.name: Red brick church
models.description: Small 19th-century Brooklyn church with a corner bell tower, pointed-arch stained glass and an iron fence.

models.name: Cobra-head street light
models.description: Grey steel NYC street light with a curved arm and an oval sodium head.

models.name: Fire hydrant
models.description: Silver NYC fire hydrant with a red top and chained caps.

models.name: Bus shelter
models.description: Steel and glass NYC bus shelter with a bench and a blank ad panel.

models.name: London plane street tree
models.description: Young London plane tree in a square sidewalk pit with a low iron guard.

models.name: Bay-window brick row house
models.description: Three-storey red-orange brick row house with a full-height rounded bay and a short stoop. Hunyuan3D Rapid tier.

models.name: Three-storey mixed-use building
models.description: Shop at street level with two brick apartment floors and a fire escape, from J-line footage. Tripo H3.1 tier.

models.name: Public school
models.description: Early-1900s four-storey red brick and limestone NYC school with a schoolyard. Hunyuan3D Rapid tier.

models.name: Flushing Av station entrance
models.description: Elevator tower, stair and el column of the Flushing Av J/M station, from Commons photos.

models.name: Kosciuszko St station entrance
models.description: Stairs to a corrugated mezzanine under the el with a red-brown canopy, from Commons photos. Tripo H3.1 tier.

models.name: Public housing tower
models.description: Mid-century cross-plan red brick NYCHA tower with a fenced lawn. Tripo H3.1 tier.
